# UI critic

Reviews interfaces for WCAG 2.2 contrast, focus order and layout issues.

## Install

Copy `ui-critic` into `~/.claude/skills/`.

## Usage

Example: review this landing page for accessibility.

files.ui-critic/SKILL.md:
---
name: ui-critic
description: Reviews a user interface for accessibility and design consistency. Use when the user shares a screenshot, a component or a page to audit.
---

# Ui Critic

## Steps
1. Check color contrast against WCAG AA.
2. Check keyboard focus order.
3. List layout and spacing issues.
